density_saturation.name: Critical density scale
density_saturation.role: Density where Θ(ρ) transitions to suppression

prohibited_variations.name: No baryon physics adjustments to compensate cosmological effects
prohibited_variations.description: Baryon feedback parameters must not absorb cosmological signal

prohibited_variations.name: No dataset-specific transition redshift z_t
prohibited_variations.description: z_t is a global parameter shared by all late-time probes

prohibited_variations.name: No galaxy bias redefinition between probes
prohibited_variations.description: Galaxy bias must be consistent across clustering and lensing

prohibited_variations.name: No independent lensing vs clustering couplings
prohibited_variations.description: Lensing and clustering must share the same underlying coupling

prohibited_variations.name: No probe-dependent Θ(ρ) or screening scale
prohibited_variations.description: Screening function must be universal across all density regimes
